purpose: Curated machine-readable navigation index for large-codebase work without loading the whole project into context.

entry_rules.start_from_symptom: Use docs/debug_playbooks.md first when the task begins from a bug or regression.
entry_rules.start_from_module: Use docs/code_id_index.md first when the task begins from a known system name or CODE-ID.
entry_rules.start_from_tuning: Use docs/runtime_switches.md first when the task begins from an inspector/runtime parameter.
entry_rules.start_from_doc_cleanup: Use docs/document_roles.md first when the task is about documentation ownership, overlap, or structure.
entry_rules.start_from_doc_manifest: Use docs/document_roles_index.json first when the task is about governed docs, required cross-links, or documentation coverage drift.
entry_rules.start_from_machine_layer: Use docs/machine_layer_audit.md first when the task is about index consistency, routing drift, or machine-readable navigation artifacts.
entry_rules.start_from_inspector_surface: Use docs/runtime_config_export.json first when the task starts from current serialized scene/prefab values, then docs/runtime_switches.md for interpretation.
entry_rules.start_from_supplement: Use supplements/supplements_index.json first for machine routing, then supplements/README.md for the human summary.
